dedupe_keys.name: kitakyushu campus twenty year district energy data

description: The Kitakyushu campus energy research team publishes long-running Japanese district-energy measurements for evaluating distributed generation and building demand. The deposit includes power, gas use, heat recovery, weather, raw records and individual-building cooling or heating loads. Its own description specifies hourly profiles for 2002–2021, while the companion repository describes a broader June 2001 to October 2022 source window and a March 2011 gap associated with an earthquake. Figshare provides ZIP packages under CC BY 4.0 for free; companion documentation identifies Excel tables and CSV preprocessing inputs. These measurements can calibrate coupled electricity, heating and cooling simulations, including building components developed with model-energyplus. A caveat is that the central published period and broader source window should not be treated as interchangeable complete series. Equipment operation and missing periods require attention when comparing years or sizing replacement systems. The observations concern one campus, so transfer to other districts needs validation. No tables were downloaded.
